headline: The combination of creative thinking, versatility, emotional IQ, and his ability to absorb and simplify complex concepts is uncanny.
quote: Ben is an amazingly talented marketer. The combination of creative thinking, versatility, emotional IQ, and his ability to absorb and simplify complex concepts is uncanny. I so enjoyed working with him as we worked to mature Cordial's messaging and bring a technical product to market. He's a keeper and one I'd invest in regardless of the business.
name: David Baker
